text.diplomatic: Do ye, O congregätion,

text.diplomatic: indeed speak righteousness?

text.reading: indeed speak righteousness?

text.diplomatic: O ye that are the sons of men,
text.normalized: O ye that are the sons of men,
text.reading: O ye that are the sons of men,

text.diplomatic: judge ye with uprightness?
text.normalized: Judge ye with uprightness?
text.reading: judge ye with uprightness?

text.diplomatic: Yea, ev’n within your very hearts
text.normalized: Yea, ev’n within your very hearts
text.reading: Yea, ev’n within your very hearts

text.diplomatic: ye wickedness have done;
text.normalized: Ye wickedness have done;
text.reading: ye wickedness have done;

text.diplomatic: And ye the vi’lence of your hands
text.normalized: And ye the vi’lence of your hands
text.reading: And ye the vi’lence of your hands

text.diplomatic: do weigh the earth upon.
text.normalized: Do weigh the earth upon.
text.reading: do weigh the earth upon.

text.diplomatic: The wicked men estrangèd are,
text.normalized: The wicked men estrangèd are,
text.reading: The wicked men estrangèd are,

text.diplomatic: ev’n from the very womb;
text.normalized: Ev’n from the very womb;
text.reading: ev’n from the very womb;

text.diplomatic: They, speaking lies, do stray as soon
text.normalized: They, speaking lies, do stray as soon

text.diplomatic: as to the world they come.
text.normalized: As to the world they come.
text.reading: as to the world they come.

text.diplomatic: Unto a serpent’s poison like
text.normalized: Unto a serpent’s poison like
text.reading: Unto a serpent’s poison like

text.diplomatic: their poison doth appear;
text.normalized: Their poison doth appear;
text.reading: their poison doth appear;

text.diplomatic: Yea, they are like the adder deaf,
text.normalized: Yea, they are like the adder deaf,
text.reading: Yea, they are like the adder deaf,

text.diplomatic: that closely stops her ear;
text.normalized: That closely stops her ear;
text.reading: that closely stops her ear;

text.diplomatic: That so she may not hear the voice
text.normalized: That so she may not hear the voice
text.reading: That so she may not hear the voice

text.diplomatic: of one that charm her would,
text.normalized: Of one that charm her would,
text.reading: of one that charm her would,

text.diplomatic: No, not though he most cunning were,

text.reading: No, not though he most cunning were,

text.diplomatic: and charm most wisely could.
text.normalized: And charm most wisely could.

text.diplomatic: Their teeth, O God, within their mouth
text.normalized: Their teeth, O God, within their mouth
text.reading: Their teeth, O God, within their mouth

text.diplomatic: break thou in pieces small;
text.normalized: Break thou in pieces small;
text.reading: break thou in pieces small;

text.diplomatic: The great teeth break thou out, O LORD,
text.normalized: The great teeth break thou out, O LORD,
text.reading: The great teeth break thou out, O LORD,

text.diplomatic: of these young lions all.
text.normalized: Of these young lions all.
text.reading: of these young lions all.

text.diplomatic: Let them like waters melt away,
text.normalized: Let them like waters melt away,
text.reading: Let them like waters melt away,

text.diplomatic: which downward still do flow:
text.normalized: Which downward still do flow:
text.reading: which downward still do flow:

text.reading: In pieces cut his arrows all,

text.normalized: When he shall bend his bow.
text.reading: when he shall bend his bow.

text.diplomatic: Like to a snail that melts away,

text.diplomatic: let each of them be gone;
text.normalized: Let each of them be gone;
text.reading: let each of them be gone;

text.diplomatic: Like woman’s birth untimely, that
text.normalized: Like woman’s birth untimely, that

text.diplomatic: your pots the thorns can find,

text.reading: your pots the thorns can find,

text.diplomatic: in blood of wicked men.
